title: Abdul El-Sayed, a Democrat, Has an Unlikely Defender: Tucker Carlson
summary: Mr. Carlson, the far-right podcaster, has promoted Abdul El-Sayed’s comments and sharply criticized his Republican rival in Michigan. Strategists are scratching their heads.
